name: Re Angel
source:
The story of a young lad named "Prach" who has an ability to see a supernatural things. Who found himself drawn into the conflict between the "Angel" and "Devil", which seems both sides are targeting for him.

Prach will encounter 4 girls in this conflict, "Fa" His sister who alway support him. "Kanlaya" childhood friend that scold him everytime in his encounter. "Manari" Devil Girl whose Intentions unclear. and "Misty," a mysterious and very mysterious charmful senior. 

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=725668975]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一名名叫普拉奇的少年，他拥有看见超自然事物的能力。某天，他被卷入“天使”与“恶魔”的冲突，而双方似乎都把他当成目标。

在这场冲突中，普拉奇会遇到四名女孩：总是支持他的妹妹法；每次见面都会斥责他的青梅竹马甘拉娅；意图不明的恶魔少女玛娜莉；以及神秘、极具魅力的前辈米丝蒂。

[来源：[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=725668975]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
